sloka: सा व्यपत्रपमाणा इव प्रतिगृह्य च दुर्मनाः ।गन्धर्व राज प्रतिमम् भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३७-१०॥
transliteration: sā vyapatrapamāṇā iva pratigṛhya ca durmanāḥ ।gandharva rāja pratimam bhartāram idam abravīt ॥2-37-10॥

translations.english: Sita of auspicious nature who knew her duties and understood righteousness, took the garments made of kusa grass from Kaikeyi. With a sense of abashment her eyes suffused with tears, she said to her husband who was the very image of the king of gandharvas.
